critique.evidence: Keyboard coverage and visible focus passed for all thesis and header controls; no thesis touch-target violations or uncontained viewport overflow were measured; reduced-motion produced zero animations or element changes. However, accessibility is not fully proven: axe marked serious color-contrast checks incomplete (3 desktop, 4 tablet, plus 12 mobile-header nodes), and the comparison grid uses aria-label on a div without a valid role. Mobile thesis scrollWidth is also 435px against a 390px viewport, though the reported excess is clipped decoration.
critique.fix: Add an appropriate semantic role or labelled structural element for the comparison grid; measure and correct actual contrast ratios for every flagged label, verdict, explanatory text, and header link across all viewports; constrain the mobile decorative inset so section scrollWidth equals viewport width; then rerun axe plus keyboard, touch-target, overflow, and reduced-motion tests with no serious incomplete results.
